tokens.name: bg-app
tokens.usage: Window chrome behind the sidebar and toolbar.

tokens.name: bg-sidebar
tokens.usage: Sidebar (page tree) background.

tokens.name: bg-canvas
tokens.usage: The page canvas. Page backgrounds (plain, dots, graph, ruled) draw on this.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Boxes, toolbar, menus, dialogs.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for rows, menu items and ghost buttons.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairlines: toolbar and sidebar edges, table cells, control outlines.

tokens.name: border-box
tokens.usage: Idle box frame on the canvas. Quieter than border so content leads.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text on surface, bg-canvas and bg-app.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, breadcrumbs, grid letters/numbers, group labels. Passes 4.5:1 on every background here.

tokens.name: text-disabled
tokens.usage: Inactive controls and unavailable pages only (WCAG exempts inactive UI). Never for readable content.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Selection, the active tool, the active page, focus rings, links. The only brand hue in the chrome.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind the active tool, active page row and selected cells. accent text on it passes 4.5:1.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a solid accent fill (primary button).

tokens.name: conflict
tokens.usage: Sync conflicts only: box frame, badge, sidebar dot. Never decorative.

tokens.name: on-conflict
tokens.usage: Text on a solid conflict fill (the Conflict badge).

tokens.name: conflict-soft
tokens.usage: Read-only and recovery banners; conflict view header.

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Formula errors (#DIV/0!, #REF!), failed saves, destructive actions.

tokens.name: ink-default
tokens.usage: Display colour of default ink (stored as #FF202124). Flips with the theme; picked ink colours never do.

tokens.name: ink-blue
tokens.usage: Ink swatch. Fixed in both themes.

tokens.name: ink-orange
tokens.usage: Ink swatch. Fixed in both themes.

tokens.name: ink-green
tokens.usage: Ink swatch. Fixed in both themes.

tokens.name: ink-purple
tokens.usage: Ink swatch. Fixed in both themes.

tokens.name: binder-green
tokens.usage: Binder colour chip and stripe. Stored value is the light one; dark shows the lifted shade.

tokens.name: binder-orange
tokens.usage: Binder colour chip and stripe.

tokens.name: binder-blue
tokens.usage: Binder colour chip and stripe.

tokens.name: binder-purple
tokens.usage: Binder colour chip and stripe.

tokens.name: binder-teal
tokens.usage: Binder colour chip and stripe.

tokens.name: paper-line
tokens.usage: Graph and ruled page-background lines. Decoration: stays below text contrast on purpose.

tokens.name: paper-dot
tokens.usage: Dot-grid page background.

tokens.name: paper-margin
tokens.usage: The left margin rule on the ruled page background.

styles.name: box-title
styles.usage: Heading 1 inside a box; dialog titles.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: North parcel drains toward the creek.
styles.usage: Note text, menus, sidebar rows, buttons.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Active sidebar row, table header cells.

styles.name: numeric
styles.usage: Table cells and the zoom readout; use tabular figures.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between toolbar buttons; icon-to-label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Row padding, gap between related controls.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Sidebar padding; toolbar group separators.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Box padding (horizontal); toolbar side padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between sidebar groups; dialog padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page header inset from the canvas edge.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Table cell selection, swatches in a square set, small chips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, toolbar buttons, sidebar rows, menu items.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Boxes on the canvas, menus, dialogs, inputs.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Badges, ink swatches, the conflict dot.

tokens.name: shadow-selected
tokens.usage: Ring outside a selected box (with an accent border). Boxes have no drop shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-popover
tokens.usage: Menus, the / menu, tooltips, dialogs. The only drop shadow in the system.

tokens.name: toolbar-height
tokens.usage: Top toolbar height (36px buttons + 8px padding).

tokens.name: control
tokens.usage: Toolbar and icon buttons on desktop.

tokens.name: touch-target
tokens.usage: Minimum control size on touch devices (iPad, Pixel, Surface in tablet mode).

tokens.name: row
tokens.usage: Sidebar row and menu item height on desktop (40px on touch).

tokens.name: icon
tokens.usage: Icon size inside a 36px control.

tokens.name: handle
tokens.usage: Resize handle squares on a selected box.

tokens.name: paper-pitch
tokens.usage: Default spacing of dot, graph and ruled page backgrounds at 100% zoom.

tokens.name: sidebar-width
tokens.usage: Default sidebar width (resizable 220–360px).
